messages:
marina: Customer (acme-inc) opened a ticket — canary rollout health chart stuck on 'In progress' for ~45m. UI shows spinning, no recent progress. They say API status endpoint sometimes returns 202, sometimes 200 with last_heartbeat:null. Escalating.

devin: thanks — can you paste rollout id + region?

marina: rollout id rlt_9a3f, region eu-west-1. I tried repro in staging and saw the chart freeze too. @luca can you take a look?

luca: looking now. quick smoke: running a count of heartbeat events into analytics: `SELECT count(*) FROM rollouts_events WHERE type='heartbeat' AND rollout_id='rlt_9a3f' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';` -> prod: 0, staging: ~180. suggests pipeline drop between state-write and analytics.

jen: FWIW we saw consumer-group `status-sync-consumers` lag spike on partition 12 earlier — lag ~240k. we restarted connector yesterday; could be offset/commit regression.

deploy-bot: New release deployed: status-sync v3.2.7 -> prod @ 1856002000 (rev=3.2.7).

devin: pulled logs from status-sync pod. seeing repeated 409s when committing state: `ERROR commit failed for rollout rlt_9a3f: 409 stale-sequence (expected=1023 got=1001)`. After 409 we backoff and do not emit state-updated event.

marina: customer says UI polling often returns `200 {status:"in_progress", last_heartbeat:null}`, and earlier got `202 Accepted` from /rollouts/:id/status. inconsistent responses.

luca: hypothesis: status-sync writes heartbeat to state-store but when write fails with 409 we currently drop the emission of the 'state-updated' event that analytics+console rely on. Dashboard therefore never receives an updated event and stays in last cached state (in_progress).

devin: repro steps I used locally:
1) `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts/rlt_9a3f/heartbeat`
2) tail status-sync logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/status-sync.log | grep rlt_9a3f`
3) consume analytics topic: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic rollouts-state-updates --from-beginning | jq '. | select(.rollout_id==\"rlt_9a3f\")'`
Observed: when status-sync returns 409 on commit, no message lands on `rollouts-state-updates` topic. When commit succeeds, message appears within ~2s.

marina: customer applied workaround: used Console -> Rollouts -> Actions -> Resync which triggered a full resync and chart moved to 100%. They also restarted the status-sync deployment (kubectl rollout restart). Both worked but customer worried about recurrence and impact to automation.

jen: proposed mitigations:
- add metric: `status_sync.commit_409_count` + alert if >5/m across a region
- ensure we emit a 'state-degraded' event even if commit fails, so analytics can show a degraded/unknown state instead of stale 'in_progress'
- add consumer-lag alert for `status-sync-consumers` > 100k

luca: agreed. I'll open a PR to change state-machine: on commit failure we should still emit a compacted event describing observed state + error code (so console can surface) and add jittered retry with circuit breaker.

devin: quick temporary patch: updated status-sync to emit a `fallback_state` message when encountering a stale-sequence 409. rolling to canary now.

oliver: informed the customer about workaround & that we have an engineering fix in flight. they want a postmortem if this hits again.

marina: since this is customer-impacting P0, suggested action list:
- luca to open PR and link here (ETA next 4h)
- devin to push canary patch and monitor for emitted fallback events
- ops (jen) to add immediate alert on consumer lag + escalate if lag persists >30m
- support (marina) to keep the customer updated and offer a one-time manual resync if it recurs

jen: added temporary PagerDuty rule for `status_sync_critical` filter on 409 spike and consumer-lag.

luca: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/status-sync/pull/642 — includes fix and tests for event emission on commit failures. request review @devin @jen. :eyes:

marina: ticket updated with workaround steps + link to PR. scheduling follow-up call with customer tomorrow. closing slack thread for now but will post when PR merges and patch rolls out. :white_check_mark:
